# prime-select

prime-rs: Select component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/select) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-select) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/select.md)

Select: port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-select`.

Markup and classes as in PrimeNG: root `div.p-select`, label `span.p-select-label[role=combobox]`, clear icon, button
`div.p-select-dropdown` and panel `div.p-select-overlay` with a search field, option list (`ul.p-select-list`, groups,
empty message) and hidden focusable boundaries. The panel lives inside the root and is positioned via `prime-dom`.

The value is a two-way signal `value: RwSignal<Option<String>>`, panel openness is `open: RwSignal<bool>`; without them
the component keeps internal state. Options are given as an `options` list or `groups`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_select::{Select, SelectOption};

let value = RwSignal::new(Some("LDN".to_owned()));
let options = vec![SelectOption::new("New York", "NY"), SelectOption::new("London", "LDN")];
let html = view! { <Select options=options value=value placeholder="Select a City" /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-select-label") && html.contains("London") && !html.contains("p-placeholder"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-select = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["select"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
